top.para: The Cyber Boardroom joins on the Start membership and offers to share its workflows and technology, all open source, against Algarve Evolution's three pillars; in return, a community with real problems.

in-short.para: The membership; the conversation with António Guerreiro; sharing, not selling; education; startups; ecosystem; what we get.

why.para: Today's Vibathon, a vision close to ours, a team partly in the Algarve, and conversations that became two articles; The Cyber Boardroom takes the Start membership.

bring.line: What we bring: what we already do
bring.para: Not a priced service: workflows and technology, all open source, usable with us or without us.

education.para: The checklist-to-app loop, explorer coding, how a memo becomes a release, and a follow-up for every buildathon app.

startups.para: Villager services, the inbox team recipe on a model account, behaviour policies and SHarness, and websites the business owns.

ecosystem.para: A newsroom under standards that can cover the region, vaults and graphs for the community map, the open-source tools, and a bridge to Web Summit.

get.para: The Start benefits, and a community of founders with real problems to test what we build.

limits.para: Membership in progress, nothing else agreed; an offer to share, not a service; figures from their site; some tools early; my interest.

sources.para: My messages of 31 October and Algarve Evolution's pages.
